measure_description: Measured with utils/measure script using 10 identical lamps connected in parallel (MULTIPLE_LIGHTS=true, NUM_LIGHTS=10) on a Shelly 1PM Gen3, because a single lamp draws below the meter's resolution floor of ~0.8 W. Reported values are per lamp. color_temp was measured with SAMPLE_COUNT=3, hs with SAMPLE_COUNT=2; measure_settings below reflects the hs run.
